title: SRS Note (Tier 0)
description: A lightweight instance with no Type binding. The lowest-ceremony entry point in SRS.

tags.description: Free-form topic labels for discovery and filtering. Not semantically defined; use Relations for semantic claims.

sections.description: Ordered list of named text sections.

sourceRefs.description: References to source material from which this Note was derived.

meta.description: Implementation-local key-value pairs. Cross-system keys should be namespaced.

name.description: Section key; unique within the Note; snake_case recommended.

tags.description: Section-level topic labels; supplements or narrows Note-level tags.

sourceId.description: Free-form when sourceType is transcript-chunk/transcript-segment/external-document. When sourceType is repository-document, MUST be a SourceDocument.documentId (format: uuid, RFC-017) — enforced by the sibling if/then.

sourceRole.description: The role the source material plays for this instance (RFC-023). Replaces relationType. 'attaches' added by RFC-017: material attachment of a source document to a record (RFC-017 [R1]).
